competences.description: Attacks the enemy to disturb HP recovery for 2 turns with a 60% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to prevent them from receiving beneficial effects for 2 turns with a 50% chance and block them from removing harmful effects for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: All beneficial effects will be blocked

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. Each hit inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns, blocks them from removing harmful effects for 1 turn with a 50% chance, and grants Suppression for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.
The HP is reduced by 50% of the MAX HP if the target uses a skill with cooldown time, and the MAX cooldown time of the used skill is increased by 3 turns.
